Variant Skin Studio - in-game colour editor for Marvel Rivals
==============================================================

Install
  1. Close Marvel Rivals.
  2. Copy the three !!SkinStudio_9999999_P files (.pak .ucas .utoc) into
     ...\steamapps\common\MarvelRivals\MarvelGame\Marvel\Content\Paks\~mods
     (make the ~mods folder if it isn't there).
  3. If you use Vortex, deploy your other mods first, then add these files.

Use
  - Press F8 in a match or the practice range to open the panel.
  - Pick a part, pick a colour row, then a swatch or the sliders.
  - Reset puts a part (or the whole hero) back to its original colours.
  - Your colours are saved per skin and come back after respawns and new matches.
  - Works alongside Project Galacta (Galacta keeps F7).

Notes
  - Colours only: texture painting needs the Skin Studio app.
  - It doesn't work in the main-menu lobby, only where your hero is on the field.
  - After a game patch this mod may stop loading or crash at launch. Remove it
    and wait for an updated version.

Uninstall
  Delete the three !!SkinStudio_9999999_P files from ~mods.
